$description: Lighting guidance for concept design. Illuminance ranges are typical residential design targets, not code requirements. Bathroom zone ingress-protection minimums follow the IEC 60364-7-701 zone concept and must be confirmed by the project's electrical consultant against applicable Indian standards before specification.

warmWhite.label: Warm white
warmWhite.use: General residential lighting, bathrooms and kitchens.

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.use: Task-intensive areas where a crisper light is preferred.

highFidelity.use: Grooming at mirrors, food preparation, wardrobes and material review.

ambient.label: Ambient
ambient.description: General, even illumination for the space.

task.label: Task
task.description: Focused light for activities such as grooming, cooking or reading.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Highlights materials, art or architectural features.

decorative.label: Decorative
decorative.description: Fixtures valued for their own appearance.

night.label: Night
night.description: Very low-level glare-free light for safe movement at night.

zone-0.label: Zone 0
zone-0.description: Inside the bath or shower tray.

zone-1.label: Zone 1
zone-1.description: Above the bath or shower area up to 2250 mm from the floor. IPX5 where water jets may be used for cleaning.

zone-2.label: Zone 2
zone-2.description: 600 mm horizontally beyond zone 1, up to 2250 mm from the floor.

outside-zones.label: Outside zones
outside-zones.description: Beyond zone 2. Humidity still applies — confirm fixture suitability with the electrical consultant.
